name: ADHD Clinic — Milestone 1: Smart Email Triage & Auto-Reply

nodes.name: 📬 Gmail — Watch New Emails
nodes.notes:
SETUP: Connect your clinic's Google Workspace Gmail account via OAuth2.
Go to Credentials → New → Gmail OAuth2 → follow the Google auth flow.
This polls every 60 seconds for new unread emails.
Only unread emails are processed — already-read emails are skipped to prevent duplicates.
Spam and trash are excluded automatically.

nodes.name: 🔧 Normalize Email Data
nodes.notes:
Extracts and normalizes all fields from the raw Gmail payload.
Separates sender name from email address.
Extracts first name for personalization.
Cleans up body text (removes excessive whitespace, caps at 3000 chars to save AI tokens).
Builds a lowercased fullText string used by the safety filter.
Output shape is consistent regardless of how Gmail formatted the original message.

nodes.name: 🚨 Safety Filter
nodes.notes:
CRITICAL SAFETY NODE — runs before ANY AI or reply logic.

Checks for 3 categories of dangerous language:
1. Legal & Complaints: solicitor, legal action, ombudsman, GDPR breach, etc.
2. Safeguarding: abuse, neglect, domestic violence, police, social services, etc.
3. Crisis & Mental Health Risk: suicide, self-harm, overdose, crisis, etc.

If ANY match is found:
- isFlagged = true
- flagCategory identifies which type
- flagReason lists the exact matched terms
- Email is routed to manual review — NO auto-reply ever sent

Add more patterns to the arrays above if needed for your specific context.

nodes.name: ⚡ Is Safety Flagged?
nodes.notes:
Routes flagged emails to immediate manual alert (true branch).
Clean emails continue to AI classification (false branch).
This is a hard gate — flagged emails NEVER reach the auto-reply nodes.

parameters.subject: =⛔ URGENT MANUAL REVIEW — {{ $json.safety.flagCategory }} | From: {{ $json.senderName }}
parameters.message:
=

⛔ Manual Review Required

This email has NOT been auto-replied to.

Flag Type:{{ $json.safety.flagCategory }}
Trigger Words:{{ $json.safety.flagReason }}
From:{{ $json.senderName }} <{{ $json.senderEmail }}>
Subject:{{ $json.subject }}

Email Body:

{{ $json.body }}
Please review and respond manually in Gmail. Do not forward this alert externally.

nodes.name: 🔴 Alert Admin — Flagged Email
nodes.notes:
Sends a formatted HTML alert email to the admin inbox.
Includes: flag type, trigger words, sender details, full email body.
Designed to be scannable at a glance so admin can act immediately.
REPLACE: sendTo with your actual admin email address.

nodes.name: 📌 Prepare Flagged Log Entry
nodes.notes:
Marks this email as FLAGGED_NO_REPLY before logging.
Ensures the tracking sheet always has a complete record,
even for emails that were never auto-replied to.
Admin can filter the sheet by status to see all flagged items.

values.content:
You are an expert email classifier for a private ADHD clinic in the UK. Your job is to analyse incoming enquiry emails and return a structured JSON classification. You must be precise, consistent, and conservative — when in doubt, use manual_review.

Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown. No explanation. No code fences. Just the raw JSON object.

=Classify this email and extract personalisation fields.

EMAIL SUBJECT: {{ $json.subject }}
EMAIL BODY:
{{ $json.body }}

Return a JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
{
  "category": one of ["adult_adhd_assessment", "child_adhd_assessment", "follow_up", "medication_query", "gp_shared_care", "general_enquiry", "manual_review"],
  "confidence": number between 0.0 and 1.0,
  "reasoning": "one sentence explaining your classification",
  "firstName": "patient or sender first name if clearly stated, else empty string",
  "isChild": true or false (is this enquiry about a child?),
  "gpName": "referring GP name if mentioned, else empty string",
  "location": "city or area if mentioned, else empty string",
  "mentionsPrice": true or false,
  "mentionsWaitingTime": true or false,
  "appointmentType": "what type of appointment they seem to need, in plain English"
}

Rules:
- Use manual_review if confidence < 0.75
- Use manual_review if the email is ambiguous or could belong to 2+ categories equally
- isChild = true if they mention their child, a young person, or ask about paediatric services
- gpName: look for 'Dr [Name]', 'referred by Dr', 'my GP is', 'from the practice of'
- mentionsPrice: true if they ask about cost, fees, prices, how much, payment
- mentionsWaitingTime: true if they ask about wait, how long, availability, next appointment

nodes.name: 🤖 AI — Classify Email
nodes.notes:
Uses GPT-4o for email classification.
Model: gpt-4o (fast, cost-effective, excellent at JSON output)
Temperature: 0.1 (very low = consistent, predictable output)
Max tokens: 800 (more than enough for the JSON response)

The system prompt is carefully tuned to:
- Return only raw JSON (no markdown wrapping)
- Be conservative with confidence scoring
- Default to manual_review when uncertain

Cost estimate: ~0.001 USD per email at current GPT-4o pricing.
REPLACE: Add your OpenAI API key as a credential.

nodes.name: 🧩 Parse AI Response
nodes.notes:
Bulletproof JSON parser for the AI response.

Handles all failure modes:
1. AI returns markdown-wrapped JSON → strips fences
2. AI returns malformed JSON → catches parse error → manual_review
3. Required fields missing → manual_review
4. Confidence < 0.75 → overrides to manual_review

Also intelligently picks the best 'firstName':
- If AI detected the patient name (e.g. 'my son Tom') it uses that
- Otherwise falls back to the sender's first name
- Last resort: 'there' (so emails never say 'Dear ,')

This node is the most defensively coded in the workflow.
Every edge case sends to manual_review rather than risking a bad auto-reply.

nodes.name: 🔀 Route by Category
nodes.notes:
Routes to the correct template branch.
Outputs: adult_adhd | child_adhd | follow_up | medication | gp_shared_care | general
Fallback (including manual_review): goes to the manual review alert node.
All 6 template branches eventually merge into the same Send Reply node.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Adult ADHD
nodes.notes:
Adult ADHD Assessment template.

TO CUSTOMISE:
1. Find the section marked PASTE YOUR TEMPLATE
2. Replace the placeholder paragraphs with your actual template text
3. Keep the firstName variable and conditional blocks
4. Update ccEmail to your adult ADHD consultant's email
5. Replace [PHONE NUMBER], [Clinic Name] etc. with real values

Conditional blocks automatically:
- Add waiting time info if patient asked about it
- Add pricing info if patient asked about cost
- Acknowledge their location if they mentioned one

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Child ADHD
nodes.notes:
Child ADHD Assessment template.
Tone is deliberately warmer and parent-facing.
Update ccEmail to your paediatric consultant's address.
Replace all placeholder values before going live.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Follow Up
nodes.notes:
Follow-Up Enquiry template.
Kept concise — these are existing patients who need a quick acknowledgement.
Update ccEmail to the appropriate admin or consultant.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Medication Query
nodes.notes:
Medication Query template.
Deliberately avoids any clinical language or advice.
Automatically CCs the prescriptions/medication team.
Always directs patient to speak with their consultant directly.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — GP Shared Care
nodes.notes:
GP / Shared Care template.
Professional, clinical tone appropriate for NHS/GP correspondence.
Auto-inserts GP name as 'Dr [Name]' if AI detected it.
CCs the GP liaison or clinical lead automatically.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — General Enquiry
nodes.notes:
General Enquiry catch-all template.
Warm and open. Acknowledges the email and sets expectations.
Update ccEmail to your general admin inbox.

nodes.name: 📤 Send Auto-Reply
nodes.notes:
Sends the personalised auto-reply.
Uses threadId to reply within the same Gmail thread (keeps conversation tidy).
CCs the relevant consultant/admin from the template node.
replyTo and sendAsEmail ensure replies come back to the clinic inbox.

REPLACE:
- sendAsEmail: your clinic email address
- replyTo: your clinic email address

All 6 template branches feed into this single send node.

nodes.name: 📋 Prepare Log Data
nodes.notes:
Prepares the log entry after successful send.
Builds: timestamp, date, time, folder name, status.
Folder name format: YYYY-MM-DD — Sender Name — Category
This ensures Drive folders are neatly organised and sortable.

nodes.name: 📊 Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes:
Logs every processed email to your tracking Google Sheet.

REQUIRED SHEET SETUP:
Create a Google Sheet with a tab named 'Enquiries'
Row 1 must have these exact column headers:
Timestamp | Date | Time | Name | Email | Category | AI Confidence | Status | Auto Replied | Subject | AI Reasoning | Location | GP Name | Is Child | Drive Folder

REPLACE:
- documentId: The ID from your Google Sheet URL
  (URL format: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/[THIS_IS_THE_ID]/edit)

Flagged emails are also logged (via the separate flag branch)
with Status = FLAGGED_NO_REPLY.

nodes.name: 📁 Create Drive Folder
nodes.notes:
Creates a new Google Drive folder for each enquiry.
Folder name: YYYY-MM-DD — Sender Name — Category
Folders are sorted chronologically automatically.

REPLACE:
- parents: The ID of your main 'Enquiries' or 'Clients' folder in Drive.
  Right-click the folder → Get link → the ID is after /folders/ in the URL.

After this node, the Drive folder link is updated in the Sheets log.

nodes.name: 🔗 Update Sheet with Drive Link
nodes.notes:
After the Drive folder is created, this node updates the same row in the sheet
with the clickable link to the new folder.
Admin can click directly from the sheet to open the patient's folder.

parameters.message:

nodes.name: 🟡 Alert Admin — Manual Review
nodes.notes:
Sends a formatted alert for low-confidence classifications.
Different colour from the safety flag (yellow vs red) so admin can
quickly distinguish between: dangerous email (red) vs unclear email (yellow).
Includes AI's best guess and reasoning so admin can see what the AI thought.
Also catches the switch node's fallback output.

_setupChecklist.description: Complete all items below before activating the workflow
items: [ ] 1. Create Gmail OAuth2 credential → replace REPLACE_GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID everywhere
[ ] 2. Create OpenAI API credential → replace REPLACE_OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_ID
[ ] 3. Create Google Sheets OAuth2 credential → replace REPLACE_GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIAL_ID
[ ] 4. Create Google Drive OAuth2 credential → replace REPLACE_GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREDENTIAL_ID
[ ] 5. Replace REPLACE_WITH_ADMIN_EMAIL with your admin email address (appears in 2 nodes)
[ ] 6. Replace REPLACE_WITH_CLINIC_EMAIL in Send Auto-Reply node
[ ] 7. Create Google Sheet with tab named 'Enquiries' and correct column headers
[ ] 8. Replace REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your Sheet ID (appears in 2 nodes)
[ ] 9. Create a parent folder in Google Drive for enquiries
[ ] 10. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PARENT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID with that folder's ID
[ ] 11. Paste your actual email templates into each Template node
[ ] 12. Replace ccEmail values in each template node with real consultant emails
[ ] 13. Replace placeholder [Clinic Name], [PHONE NUMBER] etc. in all templates
[ ] 14. Test with a real test email before going live
[ ] 15. Activate the workflow (toggle in top right)
